## New
- App icon now matches YouTube exactly: red play button on white
- Search now finds videos from every channel, but only for waz, ghazal, tilawat, Islamic cartoons, halal comedy, halal drama, news, and Islamic content; music, movies, and dance stay blocked
- 243 approved channels: waz, ghazal, tilawat, Islamic cartoons, halal comedy, halal drama, and news
- 96 news channels: Bangladeshi, international and Islamic news, a music or drama video from a news channel is still blocked
- Waz from media channels too: Charmonai, Mamunul Haque, Tariq Monowar and other famous speakers whose waz lives on media channels
- Ummah Network added at your request

## Improved
- The app opens straight to your home feed, with no setup screens
- Channel updates are now spread out, so the app uses less data at a time
- Recommendations are now off everywhere: no up-next videos, no end-screen suggestions, no discovery shelves
- Home shows only your approved channels' uploads, newest first
- The app starts faster: all approved channels are built in, with no extra lookups
- The player now blocks any video from a channel that is not approved

## Fixed
- Home no longer opens to a black screen on the very first launch
- A channel that could not be loaded has been removed from the list
- Fixed a crash that stopped the search filter from starting
- Lectures about haram topics (alcohol, gambling) are no longer hidden by mistake
